title: Profile mapping upload (BOW front end, PROFILE_MAPPING_UPLOAD)
purpose: Puts each client on the firm's BOW profiles (trading rights, contract margin, right limits, user configuration, MTM, IP and exchange identifier profiles, made in BOW), from the profile names in Connections → BOW upload files; every active client new or changed since the last file. With no profile names set the file is empty. BOW's file uploader takes it from 17:30 to 08:00.

columns.name: Login Id
columns.note: NOT NULL in BOW's sheet. The client's UCC

linked: Live RMS → Front-office files → BOW uploads (profile mapping)
